title: Read every new plan off a HiGHS log
heading: Judge a Setting on Two Measures: a Good Plan Soon, and the Proof
cases: each better plan in the progress table is read with its LP iterations
for a maximization, a higher plan is the better one
a row whose BestSol is inf has no plan in it
a row that repeats the best plan so far is not a new plan
only lines after the table's header are rows
a restart message in the middle of the table is skipped and the table goes on
a row with no source letter can still show a new plan
an LpIters count printed as 1107k is read as 1,107,000
